# Agent message examples

## A queued notification

> [PR #42 @ aaaaaaaa](https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42/commits/aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa) · Review feedback (3)
>
> `octo-manager read 1234abcd`

One command retrieves the feedback and records delivery. All examples use illustrative PRs, commits and IDs.

## Notice kinds

Each of these first lines is followed by the same read command shown above.

| First line |
| --- |
| [PR #42 @ aaaaaaaa](https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42/commits/aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa) · Merge conflict |
| [PR #42 @ aaaaaaaa](https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42/commits/aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa) · Checks failed |
| [PR #42 @ aaaaaaaa](https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42/commits/aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa) · Changes requested |
| [PR #42 @ aaaaaaaa](https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42/commits/aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa) · Review feedback |
| [PR #42 @ aaaaaaaa](https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42/commits/aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa) · Checks passed |
| [PR #42 @ aaaaaaaa](https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42/commits/aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa) · Checks completed |
| [PR #42 @ aaaaaaaa](https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42/commits/aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa) · Participants changed |
| Octo · Submission update |
| [PR #42 @ aaaaaaaa](https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42/commits/aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa) · Merge workflow update |
| Octo · Octo update |
| Octo · Issue update |
| [PR #42 @ aaaaaaaa](https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42/commits/aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa) · GitHub confirmed merge |

## Readiness states

Readiness can replace the usual check completion heading. Reading the message records delivery.

| First line |
| --- |
| [PR #42 @ aaaaaaaa](https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42/commits/aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa) · Ready |
| [PR #42 @ aaaaaaaa](https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42/commits/aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa) · Checks complete · review status unavailable |
| [PR #42 @ aaaaaaaa](https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42/commits/aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa) · Checks complete · merge prerequisites not met |
| [PR #42 @ aaaaaaaa](https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42/commits/aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa) · Checks complete · Review feedback requires owner assessment |

### Several reasons and PRs

>

### PR without a validated commit

> [PR #42](https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42) · Review feedback
>
> `octo-manager read 1234abcd`

### Custom state directory

> [PR #42 @ aaaaaaaa](https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42/commits/aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa) · Review feedback
>
> `octo-manager read 1234abcd --state '/var/lib/octo demo'`
